$comment: Feature catalog for testing agents: dotnet run scripts/Screenshot.cs -- --list. 'page' is the @page template the entry covers (checked by FeatureCatalogTests); 'route' is what gets opened (query strings like ?dialog=add-entry open UI state directly). The guest demo has pooled cash, bond and investment transactions and a small liability; there are no accounts.

features.description: Dashboard: net worth, balances and summary cards.
Portfolio cards on Assets: investments value with cost basis and benchmark, holdings, and dividend income with record, edit and delete.
Owner history grouped by day, with transaction-kind, currency, date and text filters. Add (cash, bond or investment), Import / Export menu, and edit/delete on every row.
Owner history filtered by description, counterparty or instrument and date range from the URL (?search=<text>&range=Month|1M|3M|6M|YTD).
Add transaction dialog on the Transactions page, with a Cash / Bond / Investment toggle and no account choice. ?kind=cash|bond|investment only picks the kind it opens on.
Import a cash CSV statement into the pool of one currency, without choosing an account.
Import bond entries from CSV (the file names the bond per row), without choosing an account.
Cash flow forecast: projected balance chart and horizon deltas.
Cash balance, spending, large transaction and subscription alerts.
Connect an MCP client (AI assistant) to the account.
